title: Equipotential surfaces
back: Point charge: concentric spheres. Uniform field: equally spaced planes. Always perpendicular to E.

title: E and V of a charged shell
back: Inside: E = 0, V constant (= kq/R). Outside: E ∝ 1/r², V ∝ 1/r.

title: Capacitor with a dielectric slab
back: Air gap field E₀ = σ/ε₀; inside the slab E₀/K. So C = ε₀A/[d − t(1 − 1/K)].

title: Series and parallel capacitors
back: Series: same Q, 1/C adds. Parallel: same V, C adds. The opposite of resistors.

title: Potential of a point charge
legend: V = work per unit charge from infinity (volt)
back: A scalar: add potentials of many charges with their signs.

title: Potential of a dipole
back: Zero everywhere on the equatorial line, though E is not zero there.

title: Field from potential
legend: − sign = E points towards lower potential

title: Potential energy of two charges
legend: system of charges = sum over every pair
back: Negative for unlike charges (bound). Dipole in a field: U = −pE cos θ.

title: Parallel-plate capacitor
back: Slab of thickness t: C = ε₀A/[d − t(1 − 1/K)].

title: Energy in a capacitor
back: Joining a charged and an uncharged capacitor always loses some energy as heat.

title: Dielectric inserted: battery on or off?
back: "Jude raho to V wahi, tod do to Q wahi": connected keeps V fixed (C, Q, U × K); removed keeps Q fixed (V, E, U ÷ K).
